domain_restrictions: floor is the greatest integer less than or equal to its argument
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n > 1 and all real numbers t with 0 <= t < 1: floor(n*t) equals n-1 exactly when t is at least (n-1)/n and still less than 1.
witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses are introduced; the statement is a pure equivalence between a condition on floor(n*t) and a condition on t

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with 0 <= t < 1, floor(n*t) = n-1 if and only if (n-1)/n <= t < 1.
